title: Cover registered verification association refusals and staged interrupted input
outcome: Registered verification tests pin typed association refusal attribution and staged-tree/interrupted-stage evidence behavior.
acceptance: Focused real-facade cases cover mismatched initiating session, another project's work, and changed work revision, asserting the intended typed refusal field and unchanged full database/schema snapshot.
A StagedTree case asserts exact git-tree revision and git_tree with base-commit provenance.
An interrupted Indeterminate stage with started_at and no completed_at mints no verification, and receipt/doctor row-matching remains consistent.
